# netactuate_firewall_set_available_vms (Data Source)

Reads Firewall Set Available VMs visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_firewall_set_available_vms" "example" {
  firewall_set_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_set_id` (Number) Firewall set ID whose available VMs will be listed.

### Optional

- `check_vpc` (Boolean) Check VPC eligibility when supported by the API.
- `disable_interface_id_filter` (Boolean) Disable interface ID filtering.
- `extref_account_id` (Number) External account ID filter.
- `include_bandwidth` (Boolean) Include bandwidth details when supported by the API.
- `include_ul` (Boolean) Include upload details when supported by the API.
- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vms` (List of Object) VMs available for firewall set attachment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `firewall_set_id` (Number)
- `hostname` (String)
- `iata_code` (String)
- `interface_id` (Number)
- `location` (String)
- `mbpkgid` (Number)
- `relation_id` (Number)
- `set_priority` (Number)
